target.name: BotBuilt
target.founder: Barrett Ames, Colin Devine, Brent Wadas

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $12M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
BotBuilt is a seed-stage company in Housing & Construction founded by Barrett Ames, Colin Devine, and Brent Wadas. The company has raised $12.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of five private construction-tech companies: Apis Cor, Unlimited Industries, Ground Control Development, ADMARES, and Hedral. No public comparables exist in this specific subsector.

The Stage-Progression method was applied to this analysis. Using total capital raised ($12.4M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement in this sector, the implied valuation reaches $31M. This method is appropriate given BotBuilt's current stage and the availability of financing history as an anchor point.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $36M, with a median of $31M. The relatively tight band reflects reliance on a single applicable methodology; broader triangulation across revenue multiples or DCF approaches would require additional operational metrics not present in the available data. Key uncertainties include BotBuilt's current revenue run rate, customer concentration, and product maturity relative to the private peer set—factors that could materially shift valuation within or beyond the stated range.
